meta.title: 萃取对拉花的影响：浓度决定图案
meta.title_en: How Extraction Affects Latte Art: Concentration Decides the Pattern
meta.topic: 咖啡 · 萃取与拉花实验教学

scenes.title_cn: 开场：三个流速的实验设计
scenes.title_en: Opening: Three Flow Rates, Three Concentrations
scenes.context: 仁义老师开场说明今天要讲萃取浓度对拉花的影响，设计三组实验：较快流速低浓度、正常流速、较慢流速高浓度，观察对拉花图案的直观影响。
sentences: 今天我们讲解的是关于浓度对拉花的影响。
Today we're looking at how concentration affects latte art.
concentration（浓度）
我们做三个不同的流速：较快的流速低浓度，还有较慢的流速高的浓度。
We'll run three flow rates: a fast one at low concentration, and a slow one at high concentration.
flow rate（流速）
那现在跟随我一起来进行萃取。
Now let's pull some shots together.
pull a shot（萃取一杯）
paraphrase: We'll compare a fast pour and a slow pour side by side.
Three shots on a concentration ladder.
scenes.speak: Today we're looking at how concentration affects latte art. We'll run three flow rates: a fast one at low concentration, and a slow one at high concentration. Now let's pull some shots together.

scenes.title_cn: 低浓度：颜色浅，图案锯齿
scenes.context: 低浓度少粉量萃取：14克粉萃20克液，颜色偏浅比较水。拉花图案轻微变形、有锯齿状——浓缩偏酸、支撑力不够。
sentences: 这个粉是没有装满粉碗的，我们去称一下它的重量，好，14克。
The basket isn't even full — let's weigh it. Yeah, 14 grams.
weigh（称重）
颜色偏浅，比较水。
It's pale and watery.
watery（偏水的）
图案有轻微的变形和锯齿状，这是浓缩偏酸以及支撑力不够的表现。
The pattern warps slightly and looks jagged — a sign the shot is acidic and lacks body.
lacks body（支撑力不够）
paraphrase: The espresso is on the sour side.
There's not enough body to hold the art.
scenes.speak: The basket isn't even full — let's weigh it. Yeah, 14 grams. It's pale and watery. The pattern warps slightly and looks jagged — a sign the shot is acidic and lacks body.

scenes.title_cn: 高浓度：像融化巧克力，图案最完美
scenes.title_en: High Concentration: Molten Chocolate, Perfect Art
scenes.context: 正常浓度（17克粉）流动性更好；高浓度（20克粉）萃取液像融化的巧克力，拉花图案最完整最丝滑、对比度非常高。
sentences: 正常粉量用了大约17克，明显浓度是有增加的。
At a normal dose, about 17 grams, the concentration clearly goes up.
dose（粉量）
最后我们用一个超级大的粉量20克。
Finally we go big — a 20-gram dose.
go big（用大粉量）
高浓度的浓缩咖啡，图形最完整最丝滑，对比度非常高。
The high-concentration shot gives the most complete, silkiest pattern with striking contrast.
striking contrast（对比度非常高）
paraphrase: The shot looks like melted chocolate.
scenes.speak: At a normal dose, about 17 grams, the concentration clearly goes up. Finally we go big — a 20-gram dose. The high-concentration shot gives the most complete, silkiest pattern with striking contrast.

scenes.title_cn: 结论：中高浓度与三种调节法
scenes.title_en: Takeaway: Aim High, Three Ways to Adjust
scenes.context: 对比三杯后结论：拉花需要中高浓度，颜色更深流动性更强。调节浓度不止加粉——研磨度（粗/适中/正常）与萃取比例（完整/偏少/极短）也能达到同样效果。
sentences: 对于拉花图案而言，我们需要中高的浓度，颜色会更深、流动性会更强。
For latte art you want a medium-high concentration — darker in color and easier to pour.
medium-high concentration（中高浓度）
我们也可以通过调整研磨度达到理想的效果。
You can also adjust the grind size to get the same result.
grind size（研磨度）
它对于拉花图案影响是非常之大的，大家可以去做一些测试。
It makes a huge difference to the pattern — go run your own tests.
run your own tests（自己做测试）
scenes.speak: For latte art you want a medium-high concentration — darker in color and easier to pour. You can also adjust the grind size to get the same result. It makes a huge difference to the pattern — go run your own tests.

practice.q: 「低浓度浓缩偏酸、支撑力不够」怎么表达？
practice.a: A low-concentration shot is acidic and lacks body.

practice.q: 「像融化的巧克力」用英文怎么说？

practice.a: Three ways to adjust concentration: dose, grind size, and yield ratio.

pitfalls: Blame your technique when the art looks messy.
A watery shot can't hold art no matter how steady your hand is.
Only add more coffee to boost concentration.
Also try a finer grind or a shorter yield.
Dose, grind, and yield are three equivalent levers on the same dial.
Aim for maximum concentration at all costs.
Balance body for art with a drinkable taste.
Over-extracted shots get bitter even if the art looks good.
Judge concentration by eye color alone.
Watch the flow rate and test each shot side by side.
Flow and body, not just color, tell you whether the shot is right.
shifts: 拉花失败先怀疑手法，浓度高低看运气
把浓度当可控变量，用粉量/研磨/萃比调节到中高浓度
difficult_words: A sign the shot is acidic.
The shot is acidic and lacks body.
The espresso is on the sour side.
There's not enough body to hold the art.
Test each shot side by side.
